# Teach Engineering

> > Free, NGSS-aligned K-12 STEM curriculum with hands-on engineering design activities, living labs, and standards-based lessons for educators.

Teach Engineering is an NSF-funded educational platform providing comprehensive K-12 STEM resources aligned to Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS) and Common Core Math. The site offers interactive lessons, living labs with real-world data, and design-thinking activities across engineering disciplines including renewable energy, space exploration, and computing.

## Key Topics

- NGSS (Next Generation Science Standards)
- STEM education
- K-12 curriculum
- Engineering design process
- Design thinking
- Hands-on learning activities
- Common Core Math alignment
- Living Labs
- Standards-aligned lessons
- Problem-solving
- Engineering disciplines
- Renewable energy
- Space exploration
- Computing and electronics
- Simple machines

## Core Curriculum & Browsing

- [Browse K-12 STEM Curriculum](https://www.teachengineering.org/curriculum/browse): Browse and filter NGSS-aligned K-12 STEM curriculum by grade, subject, and standards
- [Browse Curriculum by Standards](https://www.teachengineering.org/standards/browse): Browse curriculum aligned to educational standards by grade level and subject area
- [NGSS Engineering Design Curriculum](https://www.teachengineering.org/standards/ngss): NGSS-aligned K-12 STEM lessons integrating engineering design practices
- [Common Core Math-Aligned Curriculum](https://www.teachengineering.org/standards/math): Common Core math-aligned K-12 STEM lessons and hands-on activities
- [NGSS Engineering-aligned Physics Curriculum](https://www.teachengineering.org/standards/physics): NGSS-aligned physics curriculum with integrated engineering practices

## Popular Topics & Hands-On Learning

- [Popular Topics Directory](https://www.teachengineering.org/populartopics): Directory of 13 popular engineering topics for K-12 exploration and discovery
- [Simple Machines](https://www.teachengineering.org/populartopics/view/simplemachines): Popular topic: Simple machines and mechanical device exploration
- [Newton's Laws of Motion](https://www.teachengineering.org/populartopics/view/newtonslaws): Popular topic: Newton's laws with motion and forces exploration
- [Space Exploration & Spacecraft Design](https://www.teachengineering.org/populartopics/view/space): Popular topic: Space exploration and spacecraft design engineering
- [Computing & Electronics](https://www.teachengineering.org/populartopics/view/computing): Popular topic: Computing, algorithms, and electronics projects

## Living Labs & Real-World Data

- [Living Labs](https://www.teachengineering.org/livinglabs): Three interactive Living Labs: Renewable Energy, Earthquakes, and Mass Transit with real-world data collection

## Engineering Education Fundamentals

- [What is Engineering?](https://www.teachengineering.org/k12engineering/what): Educational guide defining engineering and problem-solving approaches for K-12 students
- [Why Teach Engineering in K-12?](https://www.teachengineering.org/k12engineering/why): Guide explaining STEM integration benefits and engineering design in education
- [Types of Engineering](https://www.teachengineering.org/k12engineering/types-of-engineering): Overview of engineering disciplines including biomedical, agricultural, and civil engineering

## Design Process & Methodology

- [Engineering Design Process](https://www.teachengineering.org/design/designprocess): Comprehensive guide to engineering design process emphasizing problem-solving and iteration
- [Design Thinking](https://www.teachengineering.org/design/designthinking): Design thinking methodology for hands-on problem-solving activities and innovation

## About & Organization

- [Home](https://www.teachengineering.org): TeachEngineering.org homepage: Free NGSS-aligned K-12 STEM lessons and activities
- [About Teach Engineering](https://www.teachengineering.org/about): About TeachEngineering: NSF-funded mission, organizational partners, and history
